name: InboundVerifier
purpose: Abstract extension point for provider-specific inbound webhook verification (Stripe, GitHub, Slack, internal HMAC, ...): each concrete verifier turns raw (body, headers) into a trusted VerifiedEvent or raises HTTPException — never returns None, never swallows an error.
api_signature: class InboundVerifier(ABC): name: str; @abstractmethod def verify(body: bytes, headers: dict[str, str]) -> VerifiedEvent
invariants: INBOUND_VERIFIER_INV_01: verify(body, headers) MUST either return a VerifiedEvent built from the validated payload OR raise HTTPException; returning None or silently swallowing an error is FORBIDDEN by contract.
INBOUND_VERIFIER_INV_02: Subclasses MUST set the class attribute `name` to a stable provider slug; the registry uses this name for routing and audit logs.

INBOUND_VERIFIER_INV_03: verify MUST raise HTTPException(400) on signature mismatch or malformed body and HTTPException(401) on missing required auth header; other error classes are a contract violation.
INBOUND_VERIFIER_INV_04: verify MUST NOT mutate the input body or headers dict; callers MAY pass shared references and MUST observe them unchanged after the call.
